metadata.name: Remove a verified stale Git index lock diagnosis

diagnosis.condition: Remove a verified stale Git index lock.
diagnosis.expected_state: The exact project .git/index.lock is absent, young, active, inconclusive, or outside the execution account ownership boundary.
diagnosis.probable_cause: The observed index lock stale condition differs from the required state.
diagnosis.automation_reason: Only an execution-owned regular index.lock aged at least one hour and proven unowned by lsof is quarantined; inode/hash revalidation and an exact snapshot guard both repair and rollback races.

repair_generation.name: Remove a verified stale Git index lock
repair_generation.backup_strategy: exact lock snapshot restored only while the repaired path remains absent
required_permissions: execution-account ownership and write access to the project Git index lock

action.description: Quarantine only the exact aged, execution-owned, process-unowned project Git index lock after repeated identity validation.
